name: review-ux-consistency
title: Review UX Consistency
description: Review a completed slice for user-facing consistency with the intended experience.
command_description: Inspect the slice for UX and interaction inconsistencies.
prompt: Run this reviewer after an implementation slice is complete. Inspect user-visible behavior, copy, interaction states, edge cases, and visual or workflow consistency against the PRD and the existing product language. Report concrete findings, residual risk, and any required follow-up before the slice is considered ready.
